name: Wang Chien
bio: Wang Chien is dated by Waley to about AD 830. He is represented by two poems, one on a soldier’s return from the war and one on the southern country.
The poems here are Arthur Waley’s versions in More Translations from the Chinese (1919), given with the poet’s name as spelled in those books.

poems.title: Hearing that his Friend was Coming Back from the War
poems.author: Wang Chien
poems.text:
In old days those who went to fight
In three years had one year’s leave.
But in this war the soldiers are never changed;
They must go on fighting till they die on the battle-field.
I thought of you, so weak and indolent,
Hopelessly trying to learn to march and drill.
That a young man should ever come home again
Seemed about as likely as that the sky should fall.
Since I got the news that you were coming back,
Twice I have mounted to the high hall of your home.
I found your brother mending your horse’s stall;
I found your mother sewing your new clothes.
I am half afraid; perhaps it is not true;
Yet I never weary of watching for you on the road.
Each day I go out at the City Gate
With a flask of wine, lest you should come thirsty.
Oh that I could shrink the surface of the World,
So that suddenly I might find you standing at my side.

poems.title: The South
poems.author: Wang Chien

poems.title: A Bride
poems.author: Wang Chien
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
On the third day, taking my place to cook,
Washing my hands to make the bridal soup,
I decide that not my mother-in-law
But my husband's young sister shall have the first taste.

poems.title: 詠華清宮 (Yong hua qing gong)
poems.author: Wang Chien
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
行盡江南數十程，曉風殘月入華清。
朝元閣上西風急，都入長楊作雨聲。

poems.title: 新嫁娘詞 (Xin jia niang ci)
poems.author: Wang Chien
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
三日入廚下，洗手作羹湯。
未諳姑食性，先遣小姑嘗。

poems.title: 十五夜望月寄杜郎中 (Shiwu ye wang yue ji Du langzhong)
poems.author: Wang Chien
poems.text:
中庭地白樹棲鴉，冷露無聲濕桂花。
今夜月明人盡望，不知秋思在誰家。
